text:
Sam: Quick recap from today's roadmap sync — large customer asks (Beacon + Orion) are pushing for multi-tenant and analytics in the initial demo. I'm worried that trying to deliver both will jeopardize the 2026-05-15 target. Proposing we split: MVP = SSO + single-tenant + telemetry hooks; v1 = multi-tenant + analytics UI + org admin.

Evelyn: I second splitting. Sales and CS want a demo they can sign off on; they don't need multi-tenant for the initial close. We should prepare a clear customer-facing explanation.

Marco: Engineering reality check: multi-tenant requires tenant_id propagation across services, schema migration, and new CI tests. Rough estimate 3w dev + 1w migrations + 1w testing. Not safe for the current sprint.

Tess: UX: if we hide Usage/Analytics from MVP, users in trials will ask. Suggest showing a disabled card with "Analytics coming in v1" + an "Export CSV" fallback. Keeps the UI honest.

Ibrahim: For telemetry: we need event contract and sampling plan. If we only ship hooks without UI, ops still needs logs routed to a secure bucket and retention policy documented. I'll draft the event schema.

Leah: Sales reaction: Beacon will push for the UI. If we promise v1, they want a month estimate. Can we say "targeting end of Q3, subject to capacity"?

Sam: That seems reasonable. Decision draft: keep MVP focused (SSO, single-tenant, basic quotas, telemetry hooks, CSV export), defer multi-tenant & analytics UI to v1 targeted for end of Q3. Canary rollout for MVP: 5% for 24h, verify latency/cost, then 25% for 48h. Rollback triggers: p95 latency > target or token spend >2x baseline.

Marco: Action items assigned:
- Marco -> migration appendix + risk matrix (EOD Thursday)
- Ibrahim -> event schema + sampling doc (tomorrow)
- Tess -> disabled analytics tile + CSV export flow mock (48h)
- Evelyn -> customer comms draft for Beacon/Orion + public roadmap blurb (today)
- Leah -> coordinate Beacon dry-run and expectations (schedule by Friday)
- Sam -> prepare canary config and add to rollout playbook

RolloutBot: Created card: ROLLOUT-615 "MVP canary config: 5% -> 25% with model fallback".

Leah: Small ask  - can we include a simple billing guard to prevent unlimited seats during canary? A per-org hard cap will save support.

Sam: Yes, implement a feature-flagged cap that prevents new seat creation above X during canary. Ben/Finance will accept a manual override.

Ibrahim: Note: make sure the telemetry hooks include model metadata (model_id, quantization, token count) so we can correlate cost regressions.

Tess: UX ok with that — we'll add an internal debug view for the demo team to surface model telemetry but hide it from customers.

Evelyn: OK. I'll draft the customer note and a short FAQ explaining why analytics are v1 and what's included in MVP.

Sam: Final call: defer multi-tenant and analytics UI to v1; ship MVP on 2026-05-15 with SSO, single-tenant, telemetry hooks, CSV export, and quota cap under feature flag. If no objections by EOD, I'll send the exec + CS announcement. :thumbsup:

Marco: +1
